1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem, and wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a morse taper__.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said [[first component is a humeral surface and said second component is a removably attached stem]] __humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature__.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ is spherically or elliptically shaped __and has a textured articulating surface__.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__.

12. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ has a smooth articulating surface __and wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped__.

14. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem __is selected from a plurality of stems of different lengths, wherein said selected stem__ has a [[variable]] __predetermined__ length wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw.

23. (Withdrawn) A humeral head surface protective guard comprising a protective surface.

24. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 23 further comprising a handle.

25. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 23 wherein said protective surface comprises a shell that is centrally cannulated.

26. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 25 wherein said protective surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 2.0 mm.

27. (Currently Amended) A [[glenohumeral joint]] __glenohumeral joint implant__ comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant __adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint__.

28. (Currently Amended) The [[glenohumeral joint]] __glenohumeral joint implant__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A [[repaired humerus bone]] __humerus bone implant__ comprising a modular implant with a [[humeral surface]] __humeral surface component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.

30. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.

32. (Withdrawn) A humeral implant comprising a humeral surface component and no stem.
